scope: Schedule-row identity and limitation reconciliation for the supplied nine-sheet archive excerpt. M-601 has 32 explicitly marked equipment schedule rows; M-505 adds 16 duct-silencer-design rows and 17 external-static-pressure rows. The missing plan sheets prevent conversion of any of these schedule/P&ID labels to a complete installed-equipment or physical-device count.
schedule_identity_policy: Every M-601 marked row is retained as a source schedule-row identity. A source schedule row is not an installed-unit total. M-505 duct-silencer rows are quantity/location design selections rather than individually tagged equipment. M-505 external-static-pressure rows are performance-reference rows, and overlapping FCU/DOAS marks are not silently deduplicated or expanded without the missing plans.

scheduled_families.class: Chilled-water fan coil or fan coil/combination unit as printed
Combined source schedule row for unit heaters

plan_anchor_policy: No supplied page is a mechanical plan. No schedule or P&ID label receives a plan anchor, zone assignment, or installed-quantity claim. P&ID labels are retained only in their schematic source scope.

additional_identities.quantity_semantics: Sixteen source rows include printed quantity and location/serves values; no individual silencer tags or plan locations are supplied.
Seventeen source rows cover FCU and DOAS entries. Some DOAS marks repeat for separate supply/exhaust values; the schedule does not establish additional units.
M-506 through M-512 labels on P&IDs/templates are not reconciled to an installed-equipment roster because the archive omits mechanical plans.

source_conflicts.finding: M-505 external-static-pressure rows use literal FCU and DOAS marks while M-601 uses both FCU and FCC marks. The supplied excerpt has no plan/schedule cross-reference establishing which spelling differences are aliases, so literals are retained in their respective source tables.
M-601 prints one combined `UH-1 & UH-2` row. It is retained as one source row, not recast as a single physical unit or as two fully specified separate rows.

untagged_scope.note: No generic/unmarked installed-device quantity is derived from schedule details or P&ID graphics.
